column1: CD-01: Cardless PIC / PLC - Positive Senarious

column3: Verify end-to-end successful card cash withdrawal (Savings Account)
column4:
1. Active Debit/ATM Card.
2. Sufficient balance in account.
3. Cash available in dispenser.
column5: Insert Card > Select Language > Enter valid PIN > Select Withdrawal > Select Savings Account > Enter valid amount (e.g., Rs. 5,000) > Select Receipt Option > Take Cash > Take Receipt & Card
column6: Cash dispensed successfully, account debited in SIBS/CBS, printed receipt provided, and card ejected.

column3: Verify cash withdrawal from Current Account
column4:
1. Active Debit Card linked to Current A/C.
2. Sufficient account balance.
column5: Insert Card > Select Language > Enter valid PIN > Select Withdrawal > Select Current Account > Enter valid amount > Confirm
column6: Cash dispensed, Current account debited in CBS, and receipt printed.

column5: Insert Card > Select Language > Enter valid PIN > Select Fast Cash > Choose preset amount (e.g., Rs. 1,000 / Rs. 2,000)
column6: Preset cash amount dispensed immediately, account debited in CBS, and card ejected.

column3: Verify maximum allowable single withdrawal limit
column4:
1. Active Debit Card with high balance.
2. Machine loaded with sufficient cash.
column5: Insert Card > Select PIN > Select Withdrawal > Enter max single transaction limit (e.g., Rs. 40,000 / Rs. 100,000) > Confirm
column6: System processes max limit, dispenses notes, updates SIBS/CBS balance, and prints receipt.

column3: Verify minimum allowable cash withdrawal limit
column4:
1. Active Debit Card.
2. Balance > minimum note denomination.
column5: Insert Card > Select PIN > Select Withdrawal > Enter minimum note denomination (e.g., Rs. 100 or Rs. 500) > Confirm
column6: System dispenses single note/minimum amount, updates SIBS/CBS, and prints receipt.

column3: Verify withdrawal with custom denomination selection (if supported)
column4:
1. Active Debit Card.
2. Multiple note denominations loaded in cassettes.
column5: Insert Card > Select PIN > Select Withdrawal > Enter amount > Choose denomination mix preference > Confirm
column6: System dispenses cash matching the requested note mix preference.

column3: Verify withdrawal when paper receipt is unavailable / paper low
column4:
1. Active Debit Card.
2. Receipt paper low or empty in machine.
column5: Insert Card > Select PIN > Select Withdrawal > Accept "No Receipt / E-Receipt" prompt > Enter amount > Confirm
column6: Cash dispensed successfully, e-receipt/SMS sent to mobile number, no paper printed, card ejected.

column3: Verify multiple consecutive cash withdrawals in a single session
column4:
1. Active Debit Card.
2. Sufficient balance for multiple withdrawals.
column5: Insert Card > Select PIN > Perform 1st Withdrawal > Take Cash > Select Another Transaction > Perform 2nd Withdrawal > Confirm
column6: Both transactions complete successfully, individual CBS debit postings recorded, receipts issued, and card ejected at end.
